{{Quote|Governor Graeber seized over 300 tons of weaponry in an early morning raid of a secret Rebel armory.|A [[Galaxy News Service]] report|<ref name="GNN9" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], after three weeks of preparation, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Dennix Graeber|Graeber]] led a '''raid''' on a secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] armory in [[Salibury]]'s commercial sector. 35 Rebels were captured and documents as well as 300 tons of weaponry were seized by Imperial forces assisted by Ralltiiri security forces of four countries. The raid was the largest crackdown on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] [[Ralltiir underground|underground]] since the Imperial [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|subjugation]] of the planet [[0 BBY/Legends|two years earlier]].
